description: Operational contact metadata for electronic-integrity public-records requests. Recipient fields are intentionally conservative: do not invent an email address when the current custodian must be verified before sending.

states.primaryCustodian: Arizona Secretary of State Elections Division
states.notes: Use the SOS NextRequest portal for state-maintained records. County election departments may maintain CVRs, ballot images, tabulator logs, L&A materials, custody records, detailed audit artifacts, and subcounty result exports.

states.primaryCustodian: Georgia Secretary of State Elections Division
states.notes: County election offices may maintain county-specific CVRs, ballot images, equipment logs, L&A records, and custody records.

states.primaryCustodian: Massachusetts Secretary of the Commonwealth Elections Division
states.notes: Massachusetts election records may be held by the Secretary, city and town clerks, or local election commissions. Route CVR, ballot-image, tabulator-log, L&A, audit-workpaper, and custody requests to the maintaining state or municipal custodian.

states.primaryCustodian: Michigan Department of State Bureau of Elections
states.notes: County, city, or township clerks may maintain local tabulator logs, L&A materials, custody records, and detailed CVR/reporting-unit exports.

states.primaryCustodian: North Carolina State Board of Elections
states.notes: County boards may maintain county-specific equipment logs, L&A records, custody records, and detailed post-election records.

states.primaryCustodian: Nevada Secretary of State Elections Division
states.notes: County clerks or registrars may maintain county-specific electronic election artifacts.

states.primaryCustodian: Pennsylvania Department of State Bureau of Elections
states.notes: Pennsylvania counties commonly maintain county-level voting-system records; CVR access may be restricted or require county-specific handling.

states.primaryCustodian: Texas Secretary of State Elections Division
states.notes: Texas SOS open-records routing covers Elections Division records; county election officials or other local election authorities may maintain county-specific CVRs, ballot images, equipment logs, L&A records, custody records, and detailed audit workpapers.
Municipal clerks and county clerks may maintain local CVRs, ballot images where applicable, equipment logs, L&A records, custody records, and audit workpapers.
